subject: Greenridge demo — need to reschedule due to onsite ops visit

Subject: Greenridge: Demo confirmation for July 1

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Confirming our product demo with the ops team on Friday, July 1 at 10:00 AM PT (30–40 minutes). Agenda: quick walkthrough of Redwood Optimize, live latency/cost dashboard, Q&A.

Can you confirm attendees and any topics you want us to emphasize (cache behavior, dedicated capacity sizing, or security controls)? I’ll send the calendar invite and share the slide deck ahead of time.

If anything changes, we can move — just let me know.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: demo-deck-v3.pdf (will send updated version before demo)
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@greenridge.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 13:02:19 -0400
Subject: Re: Greenridge: Demo confirmation for July 1

Hi Tessa —

Heads up: we just got notified of an unplanned on-site ops visit that starts Friday morning. A few of our ops folks who were going to join the demo will be pulled into the visit. I hate to do this last-minute, but can we postpone? Preferably next week — our Ops VP is available the week of July 5.

If you can’t move, could you record the session so we can review? Also, we still want a follow-up technical session with Marcus or an engineer once schedules settle.

Sorry for the scramble — appreciate the flexibility.

—Alex
Alex Turner
Director, IT Operations
Greenridge Health

Thanks for the update, Alex — no problem.

Options from our side:
- Monday, July 5, 10:00–10:40 AM PT (we can do a 45-minute slot to include an ops-focused Q&A)
- Tuesday, July 6, 1:00–1:45 PM PT (late-afternoon for East Coast friendly time)
- Thursday, July 8, 9:00–9:40 AM PT (Marcus can join live for deeper infra questions)

We will also record the session and send the deck. Marcus, Soojin — are you okay to be on whichever slot Alex prefers? If the Ops VP wants a separate technical deep-dive, we can schedule a 1-hr follow-up with Marcus and an engineer.

Alex, let me know which option works or propose two windows and I’ll send an updated invite.

Cheers,
Tessa
